findings.body: document_processor.py uses BeautifulSoup(content,'html.parser'), soup(['script','style']).decompose() and get_text(). That is find_all-based, with no CSS select and no direct soupsieve import. The isolated smoke on bs4 4.14.3 plus soupsieve 2.9 passed these paths and also select/select_one.
findings.title: Repo usage barely touches soupsieve

findings.body: The root uv run --frozen --offline smoke failed with ModuleNotFoundError: bs4 because bs4 was not in that default environment. This is an environment-selection limit, not a compatibility failure. It means no repo-level or dope-context service tests ran against soupsieve 2.9.
findings.title: Repo test suites not run at head
